ezekiel.38.p1.b1.text: Son of man, set your face against Gog of the land of Magog … Prophesy against him

ezekiel.38.p1.b2.text: … Behold, I am against you, O Gog

ezekiel.38.p1.b3.text: You and all your troops, and many peoples with you will go up, advancing like a thunderstorm; you will be like a cloud covering the land.

ezekiel.38.p1.b4.text: … They had been brought out from the nations, and all now dwell securely.

ezekiel.38.p1.b5.text: I will go up against a land of unwalled villages; I will come against a tranquil people

ezekiel.38.p2.b1.text: You will advance against My people Israel like a cloud covering the land.

ezekiel.38.p2.b2.text: on that day there will be a great earthquake in the land of Israel.

ezekiel.38.p2.b3.text: The mountains will be thrown down, the cliffs will collapse, and every wall will fall to the ground.

ezekiel.38.p2.b4.text: I will pour out torrents of rain, hailstones, fire, and sulfur on him and on his troops

ezekiel.38.p2.b5.text: I will magnify and sanctify Myself, and will reveal Myself in the sight of many nations. Then they will know that I am the LORD.
